parts.text: Can you tell me about the TC-1000 product? I want to know its features and pricing.

TechCorp CloudSync Pro (TC-1000) is an enterprise cloud synchronization and backup solution. Features include real-time sync, end-to-end encryption, multi-device support, 99.9% uptime SLA, and automatic versioning. Pricing starts at $29/user/month.
I keep getting error ERR-401 every time I try to log into the system. What does this mean and how do I fix it?

ERR-401 is an Authentication Failure error — your credentials are invalid or the session has expired. To fix it: clear your browser cache and cookies, log out and log back in, and if you use SSO contact your IT admin. If the problem continues your account may be locked.
Our entire engineering team of 50 people cannot access DataBridge (TC-2000) and we have a critical production deployment in 2 hours. The error code is CRIT-500. This is a business emergency!

I understand this is urgent. I've looked up CRIT-500 — it's a critical system error requiring immediate human assistance. I'm escalating this to our critical-priority support queue right away. A human agent will contact you within 15-30 minutes. Please note your ticket ID.
What's the weather forecast for London this weekend?

I specialize in TechCorp product support and I'm not able to help with weather forecasts. For weather information, I recommend using a service like weather.com or Google Weather. Is there anything I can help you with regarding TechCorp products?
I've been dealing with this AUTH-403 permission error for days and nobody has helped me. I'm extremely frustrated and considering cancelling our entire company's subscription!

I sincerely apologize for the frustration this has caused. AUTH-403 means permission denied — let me look into this right now for you. I understand this is unacceptable and I want to get this resolved quickly. Here are the steps to fix it, and I'll also make sure a team member follows up with you.
What can you tell me about product TC-9999?

I looked up TC-9999 but couldn't find any product with that ID. Our current products are TC-1000 (CloudSync Pro), TC-2000 (DataBridge), and TC-3000 (SecureVault). Could you double-check the product ID?
Who won last night's basketball game?
I'm sorry, but sports news is outside my area of expertise. I'm here to help with TechCorp product questions and technical support. Is there something I can assist you with regarding our products?
I've tried clearing my cache and re-logging in multiple times but I still can't get past the ERR-401 error. The basic troubleshooting steps didn't work for me.

I understand the basic steps didn't resolve the ERR-401 for you. Since standard troubleshooting hasn't worked, I'm escalating this to our support team who can investigate your account directly. This is a medium-priority escalation so you should hear back within 4-8 business hours. Here's your ticket ID.
